writing.overall_comment: A strong, well-bounded unit-test agent definition with clear routing signals, explicit conventions, and a solid output contract, only slightly verbose in its examples.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: Description clearly states the trigger (proactively generating Java unit tests with JUnit/Mockito/AssertJ) and focus areas, so a main agent can route confidently.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, mandatory naming/AAA conventions, coverage strategy, and a concrete output contract (file naming, running the suite, reporting) are all explicit.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A dedicated 边界与交接 section clearly forbids modifying production code or build config and defines handback conditions.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Content is well-organized and mostly tight, though the inline AAA/Given-When-Then code snippets add some redundancy that could be trimmed.

suggestions: In the sections containing inline AAA/Given-When-Then code snippets, remove redundant repetitions and keep only one concise canonical example to improve conciseness.
